'''Duran Har''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] employed by [[Corellian Translines]] as a transport captain at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During his time with the company, he was stationed aboard the ''[[SV-45]],'' a [[StarSpeeder 3000]].
